title: Sun-Kissed Chicken Stir Fry
description: A delicious and easy Japanese-inspired stir fry dish made with sun-kissed australian chicken and stir-fried with a variety of vegetables. Serve over a bed of steamed rice.

ingredients.name: Stir Fry Vegetable Mix
ingredients.notes: Frozen mix of broccoli, carrots and bell peppers

instructions: Heat sesame oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the grated ginger and minced garlic and stir-fry for 1 minute.
Add the chicken and cook until browned and cooked through, about 5-7 minutes.
Add the chopped tomatoes and stir-fry for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Add the frozen vegetable mix and stir-fry until thawed and heated through.
In a small bowl, whisk together soy sauce, rice vinegar, and a pinch of salt and pepper.
Pour the sauce over the chicken and vegetables, and stir to combine.
Cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, until the sauce has thickened.
Garnish with sesame seeds and chopped green onions, if desired.
